key_findings: SNI induces depression-like behavior in male and female rats, with early mPFC pyramidal hyperexcitability followed by hypoexcitability.
Early SNI-induced elevation of mPFC 2-AG leads to loss of CB1R function on GABAergic interneurons, proposed to cause excess GABA release and depression.
